elements.element: Services performed in a professional manner (fallback carries same substantive warranties, shorter periods)
elements.evidence: Inserted 15.4 warrants only that "Materials supplied to Ono ... shall, at the time of delivery, (a) conform in all material respects to the applicable product specifications"; no services standard appears.

elements.element: Services performed in a workmanlike manner
elements.evidence: No workmanlike standard anywhere; clause is limited to Materials conformance and GMP Manufacture.
Warranty is to "applicable product specifications" and only "in all material respects", not documentation conformance.
Ninety days is only a rejection-notice window: "Ono may reject ... by written notice given within ninety (90) days after delivery"; no express warranty period.

elements.element: 30-day services warranty period measured from performance/completion
elements.evidence: No services period stated; only "ninety (90) days after delivery" of Materials.
"Array shall, at Array's option, promptly replace such Materials ... or refund" — no repair.
"promptly replace such Materials at no additional cost to Ono"
"or refund the amounts paid by Ono for such Materials"
"(b) have been Manufactured in accordance with GMP and all other applicable Law"
No malicious code covenant appears in the inserted 15.4.
Only "within ninety (90) days after delivery" notice window; no 12-month software period.
Clause addresses only Materials; no services standard.

reasons: The insertion creates a goods-conformance warranty for Materials but omits the fallback's core elements: professional and workmanlike services standard, documentation conformance, an express 90-day software warranty period, a 30-day services period from performance, and a repair remedy.
The ninety-day figure is a rejection-notice window rather than a stated warranty duration, so the official period check fails.
Conformance is qualified "in all material respects", which the playbook does not permit at the fallback where conformance is required.
Remedy is at Array's option (replace or refund) rather than repair, replace or refund; only two of three remedies appear.
Drafting is contained, adds no new exceptions and leaves the existing 15.4 disclaimer and supply provisions effective, so minimality and intent are preserved — but the level target is not achieved.
